name: Mali (1959–1961)
description: Three equal vertical stripes of green, yellow and red with a black kanaga, a stylised human figure with raised arms, on the yellow stripe.
history: Flag adopted on 4 April 1959 when the Sudanese Republic joined Senegal in the Mali Federation, with the kanaga figure of Dogon art on the pan-African tricolour. After the federation broke up in August 1960 the independent Republic of Mali removed the figure, under pressure from Islamic opinion against depicting the human form, on 1 March 1961.
